description: ALVAO IT Asset Management (ITAM) gives organizations full lifecycle visibility and control of IT hardware and software, cutting down manual work with an intuitive tree-structured interface. With real‑time discovery via network monitoring systems, Agent, SNMP,Intune, and SCCM integration, it simplifies audits, optimizes licenses (including Microsoft 365), and supports compliance with Cyber Essentials, NIST, NIS2, and DORA. A visual CMDB maps dependencies for faster incident resolution and change planning, helping IT teams stay efficient, compliant, and cost-effective.
